gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We are an art-loving, art-making, art-sharing community hub in the heart of Mathews County, Virginia. Our family of artists teach over 100 art and craft classes each year in and out of our building, run a community pottery studio, and share the beauty and magic of art in the Art Speaks Gallery.
